profile.role_note: Negative Status support; raises stack caps for Chafe, Bane, Flare, and Rage teams.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: The premier Negative Status support — essential for Chafe, Bane, Flare, and Rage teams thanks to her stack-cap raising; pull if you run status carries.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Firstlight's Herald (or Variation) + 5-piece Song of Feathered Trace in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Forbidden Bastion in the main slot. Aim for a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, HP% 1-costs, and 260% Energy Regen to maximize her buffs and healing.

ranked_weapons.name: Firstlight's Herald
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. 77% Energy Regen, Max HP, Concerto Energy on Liberation, and a 20% team ATK buff when she inflicts Glacio Chafe and heals.

ranked_weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
ranked_weapons.note: 5-star alternative; Energy Regen, HP%, and team ATK buff.

ranked_weapons.name: Variation
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star; Energy Regen and Concerto Energy on skill. Fast, clean rotations.

echo_sets.name: Song of Feathered Trace
echo_sets.note: Synergizes perfectly with her kit: 25% ATK buff to allies when she applies Glacio Chafe; Forbidden Bastion adds Healing Bonus. Game8's build index also lists a 3-4-3-1-1 variant.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Longer 15% ATK boost plus 10% Healing Bonus; weaker than Feathered Trace but viable early.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus; her kit scales off healing and Energy Regen, not damage stats.
Energy Regen on both 3-costs; 260% total is the target.

teams.name: Premium: Hsin + Electro Rover + Suisui

members.name: Hsin
members.note: Electro Flare hypercarry; gains Electro DMG Bonus from her unique Intro interaction with Electro Rover.

members.name: Electro Rover
members.note: Bulk Electro Flare applicator; funnels ATK and All-DMG amp to Hsin.

members.name: Suisui
members.note: Raises Electro Flare and Electro Rage stack caps; heals and amplifies team damage.

teams.rotation: Suisui opens to build Forte and apply her buffs, Outro to Electro Rover for Flare stacks and the Intro interaction, then Hsin enters to build resources and detonate with her Liberation.

teams.name: Alternative: Hiyuki + Lucilla + Suisui

members.name: Hiyuki
members.note: Converts Glacio Chafe into Glacio Bite for her burst windows.

members.name: Lucilla
members.note: Premier Glacio Chafe applicator with Glacio-related buffs.

members.name: Suisui
members.note: Increases the max stack limit of Glacio Chafe alongside her heals and DMG buffs.

teams.rotation: Suisui builds Forte and buffs, Lucilla applies Chafe stacks and nukes in Reminiscence mode, then Hiyuki converts stacks into Glacio Bite burst.
